author: 1v1Me_
body:
Hey Guys its me KingR10, and I just was wondering if any teams need any team members well heres my application!


Pros: I am good at rushing a defending. I have managed my goal yesterday (woot woot) on getting all the mons on every map (I think I got every Map). When I defend it is hard for people to get the Monument. I have mastered the art of defending and rushing (not as good as the Legends though) Now lets get into my PvP skills. Look At my KD... It BLOWS. It is leteraly unbearable. On some of my alt accounts hehe my secret. It is good because I focus it a lot. I am actually not that bad at PvP though. I can put up a fight and go on my own.
Cons: Get pist off when some1 combat logs, but I can control that. I am not the best Midfielder. 
Desired position: Rusher/Defender

Skype: zbot300

And one last thing. If you ever see me in game and want to see how good I am actually, do the good old /leave and /tp KingR10 and maybe watch me for a sec...

Well on that note
Cheers
-KingR10
